SG-load-prepare.text: public_1ubq.cif loaded and prepared through the structure screen

SG-no-candidate-set.text: before any M20 set the sequence GA area shows 사용할 수 없음 with the reason only (no number, no input, only the list re-read button, no POST)

SG-candidate-sets.text: M20 screen: the tiny set (I3 protected, K6, I44, G76; allowed A W) whose candidates and positions equal the T1 fixture and the oracle space, and an I44W-only set

SG-ligand-imports.text: phenol, planar and implicit-H SDFs imported through the docking area; back on 단백질 공학 the area remounts and reads its lists with GET only

SG-initial-state.text: nothing chosen, submitted or approved automatically: no set, SDF or box, confirmations and acknowledgements unchecked, GA seed empty, defaults prefilled, both buttons blocked with the reasons, 빈 결과, capability line

SG-param-guards.text: each of the 11 GA keys out of range (and the GA seed empty) blocks 시작 전 확인 and 서열 GA 시작 with the field's reason (invalid_job_arguments); no request

SG-cross-rules.text: population − elite < 2 and max new < population: blocked at the named field; no request

SG-defaults.text: 기본값으로 restores every spec 2 default and keeps the GA seed; range/default text per field; the effective summary with the job time limit total_s + 600

SG-confirmations.text: a missing rebuild_pH7 confirmation or acknowledgement blocks the preflight with "… (confirmation_missing)" / "… (acknowledgement_missing)"; no request

SG-refusals.text: preflight refusals ga_space_too_small (6 < 8 at max_mutations 1; the I44W set 1 < 4) and ligand_not_3d (planar SDF) shown as "한국어 (code)" with the server detail; no job, no event, no charge

SG-preflight.text: GA 1 preflight: space 3/6/26 (cap 3) in ②, 602 heavy atoms and no 4,890 warning line (server flag), reserved 13 evaluations / 28 units, need, remaining, shortfall and may-be-partial = spec 7 arithmetic; S1 S4 S5 S6 verbatim; the view shows the server numbers

SG-limit-approval.text: shortfall → approval control, start blocked (ga_limit_raise_required); the screen's button raises by the shortfall only (by human, sequence GA context, no job/object/charge), the preflight is read again with no shortfall, nothing starts by itself (GA 1, GA 1 again, GA 4)

SG-run.text: real sequence_ga_dock_v1 GA 1: the run's first expensive call approval, 작업 시작, done; timeout total_s + 600; exactly reserved_units units; summary listed, not opened

SG-progress.text: while running, the progress line and data attributes equal the stored job record (reference row recorded, generations, new evaluations)

SG-results.text: status, stop reason (no_change = 점수 최솟값 변화 없음), S sentences, summary lines, the reference row apart from the table, generation tabs and every row (mutations from the set with 7 fields, origin, parents, evaluation, state, score = stored M18 first mode ROUND_HALF_UP) = stored; carried rule; min/max as values

SG-oracle-path.text: GA 1's stored path = the T1 independent oracle vector s4_tiny_observed (keys, origins, parents, edit ops, evaluations, indices, states, scores, stop)

SG-sort.text: slot/key/score headers both ways follow the stored values; rows without a score last; aria-sort; no rank column

SG-detail.text: individual and reference detail = the stored mutation_set_model@1 values only (mutations, potentials with S5, HIS/CYS states and differences, disulfides, PDBFixer atoms, model limitations) and the stored M18 result detail

SG-download.text: individual and reference mmCIF downloads: bytes SHA-256 = stored structure_sha256 = backend bytes

SG-dedupe.text: GA 1 arguments again: preflight names the existing job; 서열 GA 시작 shows that job (no new job, object or unit)

SG-reuse.text: GA 2 (other GA seed, same evaluation seed): reused individuals and the reference row cite GA 1's stored model and result (재사용), new objects = new evaluations, reserved_units charged once, S3

SG-partial.text: GA 2 stops at evaluation_limit (new = reserved evaluations), stopped generation marked, partial, S2

SG-cancel.text: GA 3 cancelled from the screen while running: cancelled job, partial / cancelled summary with the finished individuals, S2, no worker/modeling child/qvina2 left, no refund

SG-reference-failed.text: GA 4 (implicit-H SDF, admitted by the server): the reference row fails in docking (reason "한국어 (code)", score —, never 0), no generation, partial / reference_failed, S2, stored reference model shown without an M18 result; reserved units charged

SG-late-response.text: a held summary-detail response released after switching to another summary is not applied

SG-report.text: 보고서 만들기 → saved and listed for the summary (no new GA object, no unit); Markdown/JSON downloads = backend bytes; 지식·보고서 lists 서열 GA 보고서 and reopens the saved Markdown; global budget = backend

SG-tabs.text: back on 단백질 공학 the area remounts (GET only, nothing opened); M20, M21, sequence GA areas in order; the 구조 분석 panel stays mounted, hidden and inert; the four tabs unchanged

SG-processes.text: no GA worker, modeling child, docking worker, guardian or qvina2 process under the runs folder

SG-wording.text: no rank/best/improvement/winner/recommendation/comparison/difference/average/effect/affinity/stability word in the sequence GA area outside the fixed and stored sentences and the score names

SG-no-run.text: no run: the sequence GA area shows only the no-run reason (no numbers, no controls, no request)

SG-unavailable.text: backend without the locked docking environment: 사용할 수 없음 with the capability reason (worker_missing), no numbers, no controls, no sequence GA request

SG-repro-runs.text: two fresh runs replay GA 1 through the screen (load, prepare, M20 tiny set, phenol import, the same inputs and values, the screen's limit approval, run to done)

SG-reproducible.text: the flow's GA 1 replayed in two fresh runs of the same backend process: the summary and every evaluated row's model and M18 result (contents with the run-scoped obj:// handles and the hashes over them replaced) and the poses SDF bytes equal the flow's (cpu 1, GA and evaluation seeds fixed)

SG-oracle-paths.text: the flow's GA 1 and GA 2 stored paths equal the independent T1 oracle on the T1 real-engine first-mode table (GA 2 with GA 1's stored rows as the reuse index)

S-no-egress.text: non-loopback requests 0 and zero provider calls on every flow row
